segments.title: How long did it take to REACH Mercury?
segments.say: How long did it take to fly to Mercury? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: About 8 YEARS!
segments.say: About eight years! It launched back in twenty eighteen.

segments.title: It's called BepiColombo
segments.say: It's BepiColombo, from Europe and Japan.

segments.title: In orbit since Nov 21
segments.say: On November twenty first, ESA announced it's now in orbit around Mercury.

segments.title: Why SO long? Braking!
segments.say: Why so long? The Sun's pull speeds you up, so it looped around to brake.

segments.title: Only the 2nd ever
segments.say: It's only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury.
Follow for Guess It number 29 tonight.
